sourceText:
Ajar
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, January 1, 2010 - 11:54pm

Ingredients




3 tablespoons Rice vinegar
1 tablespoon Sugar
1/2 teaspoon Salt
1 d Black pepper
1 medium Cucumber, peeled
1/2 cup Red onion, thinnly sliced
2 tablespoons Cilantro leaves, chopped
1 small Fresh red or green chili

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl, stir vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper until sugar & salt are dissolved. Quarter cucumber lengthwise. Remove seeds. Cut quarters crossswise into 1/8" thick slices. Add cucumber, onion, cilantro & chili to vinegar dressing; toss until combined. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
